meta.name: add-discord
meta.description: Add Discord bot channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Discord 机器人频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Discord 机器人消息通道。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Discord bot channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add a Discord bot channel to your application.

howto.what: 让 Claude 能通过 Discord 机器人收发消息，在服务器频道或私信中对话。
howto.when: 当你说出“添加 Discord 通道”等要求，或正在 /setup 流程中需要接入 Discord 时触发。

say.text: 帮我添加 Discord 通道
say.note: 将开始复制适配器、注册并配置机器人。

say.text: 设置 Discord 机器人并连接
say.note: 会引导你创建应用、填令牌并重启服务。

say.text: 把机器人加进我的服务器并开通私信
say.note: 完成邀请与 DM 通道绑定。

howto.what_en: Adds Discord bot support so Claude can send and receive messages via Discord servers or DMs.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to add a Discord channel or during the /setup flow when Discord integration is requested.

say_en.text: Add a Discord channel for me.
say_en.note: Starts copying the adapter, registering, and configuring the bot.

say_en.text: Set up a Discord bot and connect it.
say_en.note: Guides you through creating an app, pasting the token, and restarting.

say_en.text: Invite the bot to my server and enable DMs.
say_en.note: Completes the invite and binds the DM channel.
